attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "The validation/population logic for AzureAISearch index profiles is expanded from content-only indexes to all index types with this provider, and the Properties merge logic changed from a full replace to a key-by-key merge, both of which could silently alter behavior for existing non-content indexes or profiles relying on property replacement."}

reason: The validation/population logic for AzureAISearch index profiles is expanded from content-only indexes to all index types with this provider, and the Properties merge logic changed from a full replace to a key-by-key merge, both of which could silently alter behavior for existing non-content indexes or profiles relying on property replacement.
